note_en: Chip stocks stayed volatile after Thursday's Mag7-led selloff; broader tape stabilized Friday. S opened an AT&T long, P booked a small SMCI gain, T stayed flat (outside its Tue/Thu window). Note: today's pre-market gather and picks-publish never ran (repo-mount race, since fixed), so no fresh picks pool was available today.
note_zh: 芯片股在周四七巨头抛售后仍有波动，周五大盘趋稳。S新开AT&T多头，P兑现SMCI小额收益，T因不在周二/周四窗口内保持不动。注：今日盘前收集与推荐发布均未运行(仓库挂载竞态问题，现已修复)，故今日无新推荐池。

books.note_en: Opened a long in AT&T (T), 84 shares — its only trade today. Equity ticked up ~0.4% to $10,079 (+0.79% cumulative).

books.note_en: Sold SMCI (64 sh) for a realized gain of ~$22, its only trade today. Equity up ~0.2% to $10,022 (+0.22% cumulative).

books.note_en: No activity — Friday falls outside T's Tue/Thu open window, it holds no positions, and today's picks-publish never ran (see regime note) so there was no candidate pool anyway.
